headline: Airlines Pull Back on Fuel Hedges as Iran War Drives Up Jet Fuel Prices
summary: Airlines scaled back on fuel hedges as jet fuel prices hovered around twice their pre-conflict levels amid Middle East supply crunches, warning of rising fares.
why: Elevated jet fuel prices and reduced hedging cover increase cost volatility for commercial airline operators.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Unhedged exposure to doubled jet fuel prices squeezes operating margins.
